name: cortex_think_about_memory_maintenance
description: Periodic memory maintenance checkpoint. Call this to review the overall health of the memory store. Returns a prompt with memory statistics and a sample of memories from each layer, asking you to identify maintenance actions: mark obsolete outdated memories, promote valuable episodic to semantic, merge related memories, or update inaccurate content. Call this periodically or when the user requests memory cleanup.

focus_level.description: Optional: focus review on a specific memory level

focus_tags.description: Optional: focus review on memories with specific tags
